expected._note: barrels of each body color in the frame, counted by eye from the raw frames (Claude, 2026-11-07); superseded by Tanush's box labels when they exist. held_01: a blue barrel in the kicker (lid only) plus clutter.

judgments._note: Hand verdicts from the sheets and the stage probes (Claude, 2026-11-07). verdict: ok = right count and placement; seg = the segmentation left the barrel without body pixels (prior / floor / box), so no stripe could be anchored; det = body pixels were there and the stripe step failed; seg+det = both. Mechanisms named: 'prior' = the background prior fit on the top 50 rows, 'floor' = the per-image saturation floor from the same rows, 'box' = the RGB class box, 'glued shadow' = unlabeled shadow attached to the stripe makes its band too tall (pre-registered detector flaw b), 'wrong color' = a box of the other color (flaw c).
